info.longBusinessSummary: Griffon Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides home and building, and consumer and professional products in the United States, Canada, Australia, and internationally. The Building Products segment manufactures and markets residential and sectional commercial garage doors, rolling steel service doors, fire doors, shutters, steel security grilles, and room dividers. It also provides residential, industrial, and commercial ceiling fans under Hunter, Casablanca, and Jan Fan brands. The company also sells garage door openers. In addition, this segment provides home organization products and lawn and garden products. It serves home centers, warehouse clubs, discount stores, commercial distributors, and e-commerce companies. The company was formerly known as Instrument Systems Corporation and changed its name to Griffon Corporation in January 1995. Griffon Corporation was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
